description: The official Gitea MCP server (gitea.com/gitea/gitea-mcp, MIT) run in the workspace over stdio, one process per server in a set. One entry serves every Gitea: each server in a set gives its host in GITEA_HOST and its own token file. Needs the gitea-mcp binary at this path in the workspace image (not there yet). Tool output (issue and PR text) is untrusted data.

slots.name: GITEA_HOST
slots.description: The Gitea this server talks to, like https://git.konfersi.com. One host per server.

slots.name: GITEA_ACCESS_TOKEN_FILE
slots.description: Path of the Secrets & env file holding a Gitea access token for this host only. gitea-mcp reads the file itself, so the token is in no environment variable.

slots.name: GITEA_READONLY
slots.description: true hides every write tool (gitea-mcp compares the value with exactly true).

slots.name: GITEA_SCOPES
slots.description: Comma-separated tool scopes to load (repository, issue, pull_request, ...). Empty loads all.
